title: Localization and target-unit transport for termwise exchange
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{et}))$, $J$ a bounded-below injective complex, and $q:K\cong QJ$. Let $U,P,F$ be respectively strict-local inverse image, its base-changed inverse image, and base-changed direct image. Set $H=[J]$ and lift $q$ to $q^\prime:K\cong Q_hH$. The image in $D$ of the bounded-below composite of the exact $U$ localization comparison, the localized underived exchange [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange], the target $R^+F$ unit, and $R^+F$ of the inverse exact $P$ comparison followed by $P(q^{\prime -1})$, precomposed by the inverse complex-level $U$ comparison, equals $Q$ of termwise exchange followed by the unbounded $RF$ unit and $RF$ of the exact inverse-image transport by $q^{-1}$, with the canonical quotient comparisons and the inverse bounded-below/unbounded compatibility as the last factor. No derived mate occurs and no target unit is inverted.

proof.text: Form the bounded-below complex M = ιJ and its homotopy quotient H. For the exchange prefix, map both factors through DerivedCategory.Plus.ι, use ι_map_mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh_hom_app and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app, and cancel the complex-level U comparison. The quotient comparisons and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors at a quotient complex are identity. The inclusion of NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategoryPlus is NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory, hence the remaining exchange is Q of the complex-level exchange. This is the private exchange_localization_prefix calculation.

For the suffix use the defining rightDerivedUnique unit compatibility for rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. Postcompose its hom identity with the inverse compatibility and use naturality of that inverse on the transport morphism. The inclusion of the inverse exact P comparison is its unbounded inverse, as follows by cancelling the corresponding hom comparison. Full faithfulness maps q′.inv to quotientCompQhIso.hom followed by q.inv. Expand the homotopy factorization at M; the quotient comparisons are identity and its inverse equals the complex-level inverse P comparison. This is the private target_unit_representative_transport calculation. No target unit is inverted.

Postcompose the prefix equality with the included target suffix. Precompose the suffix equality with the unbounded exchange prefix. Compose these two equalities, expand functoriality, and reassociate to obtain the original displayed equality unchanged.
